summary: Grupo Financiero Galicia S.A. filed a 6-K on June 30, 2026, announcing a cash dividend of Ps. 39,999,772,000 (Ps. 24.9025239772688 per share) payable in three equal installments in July, August, and September 2026. The board resolved the dividend on June 30, 2026, per the April 28, 2026 shareholders' meeting. The dividend represents 2,490.2524% of par value. Payments are subject to a 7% Argentine withholding tax and potential deductions for Personal Asset Tax. ADR holders will receive payment through Bank of New York Mellon. Watch for currency conversion mechanics and tax treatment, though this is a routine cash return, not a special situation.
